According to the 2022 cobalt-free review, the total usable cobalt from known reserves is approximately 2 million metric tons. The NFA paper estimates that one fleet of one million EVs with NMC 111 cathodes would require approximately 700 tons of cobalt. 

To calculate the number of fleets that the total usable cobalt from known reserves could supply, we can divide the total usable cobalt by the amount of cobalt needed for one fleet:

2,000,000 metric tons / 700 metric tons per fleet ≈ 2,857 fleets

So, the total usable cobalt from known reserves could supply approximately 2,857 fleets of one million EVs with NMC 111 cathodes.

expect: ~2 million metric tons (aenm-2022 p1.L42-47) / ≈2500 tons per million EVs (adma-2020 p2.L93-96) = ~800 fleets
